headline: LinkedIn: B2B buyers trust proof from their peers
dek: A review of 700 B2B case studies by LinkedIn, WARC and Lions Advisory found campaigns with three or more trust signals, like testimonials and peer validation, performed far better.
why: B2B and IT firms often market on features and certifications, while this research says buyers respond to proof from peers like them.
doThis: Turn two customer wins into short quote cards or videos and run them for a month.
